- Launch siren off‑state visibility corrected.

### Health & Alerts
- Health Threshold toggle added, allowing players to set custom health warning levels in the HUD.

items.text: Fixed frog animation issues where frogs were not playing animations, skating sideways, and had incorrect movement speed.
Medkit now reduces radiation by 20, matching the effect of two syringes.
Longsword swing radius increased to 0.4 and swing delay reduced to 1.5 for faster, more accurate attacks.
SAM site gains proximity‑fuse missiles against drones, 2.25× faster lead targeting, and can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air. (WIP)
Added tunable convar to adjust drone detonation distance, affecting SAM vs drone engagements.
Unused pies receive small buffs; bonus duration doubled for bigcat, hunters, pork, fish, and chicken pies. Hunters pie bleed reduction increased to 90% from 75%.
Boat Planner tech tree cost reduced from 120 to 30, making boat planning cheaper.
Swamp tree wood harvest amount increased from 300 to 1000, boosting wood yields.
Suspension, steering, and grip tweaks improve handling; burnout/launch attempt removed; engine revs now use front wheel speed; rear wheels lock visually during handbrake.
Additional handling tweaks: prevent duck‑toggle getting stuck with handbrake, apply raw tyre force regardless of handbrake, and ensure non‑car vehicles are not affected by handbrake changes.
Aim sway for weapons in the passenger seat of attack helicopters now scales with movement speed, adding realistic in‑flight aiming.
Health bar now displayed when damaging monument blockers, providing visual feedback.
Fixed hotbar swapping when items are overstacks; RPC moved server‑side to handle overstacks correctly.
Repair bench functionality restored, fixing crafting issues.
Store prop drawer UI bug fixed; added fallback path for missing images.
Potential null‑reference crash in FadeCanvasGroup addressed.
Possible NRE fix for mannequins to prevent crashes.
Arrow revamp icon issues corrected.
Prevented building volumes from being baked into the navmesh, ensuring they are ignored during path generation.
Fixed navmesh generation in invalid areas and improved NPC path‑following performance.
HAB armour now consists of breakable chunks; individual pieces can be destroyed, and the frame remains once all chunks are gone.
TC upkeep cost now scales with the number of authenticated players: first 4 add 0%, next 6 add 2% each, further players add 4% each; deauthentication takes 24 hours to stop affecting upkeep.
Group upkeep also counts unique players authenticated on code locks linked to a TC, with the same 24‑hour decay; can be disabled via decay.upkeep_group_count_locks.
Livestock now have a water‑drinking need and will seek nearby water containers or natural sources.
WIP: Frogs have an "interested" state where they search for shallow water and croak.
Stables_b is now playable in the editor, introducing a basic animal‑selling mechanic with NPC dialogue.

Oil rig event now preserves crate states across server restarts; puzzles force‑reset only when no players are nearby, preventing death during shutdown, and crates continue hacking progress after restart.
Homing launcher UI now shows "Keep on target" text and its lock‑on timer has been reduced by 30 %.
Russian roulette DLC adds ammo model indicators for remaining rounds and a new chain connector model for python pick cases.
Fixed a crash caused by stale Rust.Native binaries; latest binaries are now used, eliminating the exception on Windows Craggy startup.
Fixed frog animation glitches, corrected sideways skating and movement speed, and added a new water‑seeking 'interested' state where frogs croak and move toward shallow water.
Added a drinking water need for livestock, allowing them to hydrate from containers or natural water sources.
Enabled Stable B for animal trading, introducing basic NPC conversation and selling mechanics for animals.
Added restoreHierarchy flag to pooled vehicles, fixing UI pooling issues for vehicle objects.
Improved car handling: fixed handbrake logic, prevented duck toggle lock, applied raw tyre force, refined suspension, steering, grip, and added visual rear‑wheel lock during handbrake.
Introduced a configurable setting to adjust the drone detonation distance and updated helicopter passenger seat weapons to apply aim sway scaled by movement speed.

Various UI stability and visual fixes: health bar now shows when hitting monument blockers, store prop drawer fallback image added, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference crash prevented, arrow revamp icons corrected, and homing launcher UI now displays 'Keep on target' with lock‑on timer reduced by 30%.
Hotbar now allows swapping of overstacks via server‑side RPC, repair bench functionality fixed, and random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible outcome.
SAM sites receive new anti‑drone buffs: proximity‑fuse missiles, 2.25× speed lead without aim error, and ability to destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air.

- Improved car handling: fixed handbrake logic, prevented duck toggle lock, applied raw tyre force, refined suspension, steering, grip, and added visual rear‑wheel lock during handbrake.
- Introduced a configurable setting to adjust the drone detonation distance and updated helicopter passenger seat weapons to apply aim sway scaled by movement speed.

### UI & Inventory
- Various UI stability and visual fixes: health bar now shows when hitting monument blockers, store prop drawer fallback image added, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference crash prevented, arrow revamp icons corrected, and homing launcher UI now displays 'Keep on target' with lock‑on timer reduced by 30%.
- Hotbar now allows swapping of overstacks via server‑side RPC, repair bench functionality fixed, and random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible outcome.

### Gameplay & Balance
- SAM sites receive new anti‑drone buffs: proximity‑fuse missiles, 2.25× speed lead without aim error, and ability to destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air.
